# telnyx_ai_assistant_canary_deploy (Resource)

The canary deployment of an AI assistant, which routes matching conversations to other versions of the assistant. An assistant has at most one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Send a tenth of the conversations to a new version of the assistant, and
# every conversation from the beta team to it.
resource "telnyx_ai_assistant_canary_deploy" "front_desk" {
  assistant_id = telnyx_ai_assistant.front_desk.id
  rules = [
    {
      match = [
        { attribute = "team", operator = "in", values = ["beta"] },
      ]
      serve = {
        version_id = var.candidate_version_id
      }
    },
    {
      match = []
      serve = {
        rollout = [
          { version_id = var.current_version_id, weight = 90 },
          { version_id = var.candidate_version_id, weight = 10 },
        ]
      }
    },
  ]
}

variable "current_version_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "candidate_version_id" {
  type = string
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `assistant_id` (String) The assistant id.

### Optional

- `rules` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Optional:

- `match` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--match))
- `serve` (Attributes) What a rule serves when matched. Exactly one of: - ``version_id`` — serve a specific version - ``rollout`` — weighted random across versions; weights must sum to less than 100, with the leftover routing to the main version (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--serve))

<a id="nestedatt--rules--match"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.match`

Optional:

- `attribute` (String) Attribute name from the routing context
- `operator` (String) One of `in`, `not_in`, `starts_with`.
- `values` (List of String)


<a id="nestedatt--rules--serve"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.serve`

Optional:

- `rollout` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--serve--rollout))
- `version_id` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--rules--serve--rollout"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.serve.rollout`

Optional:

- `version_id` (String)
- `weight` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_ai_assistant_canary_deploy.front_desk <assistant_id>
```
